page.metaTitle: NIS2 Asset Inventory (Strukturanalyse) — free, no signup
page.metaDescription: Free guided tool to build your first BSI Grundschutz 200-2 §8.1 Strukturanalyse. Captures business processes, applications, IT systems, rooms and communication links in the BSI 5-layer Informationsverbund.

hero.headline: NIS2 Asset Inventory
hero.subhead: Walk through everyday categories in plain language. Output: a structured Informationsverbund per BSI Grundschutz 200-2 §8.1, ready to feed into your risk assessment.

intro.trustLine: BSI-200-2 §8.1 Strukturanalyse five-layer model. NIS2 Art 21(2)(i), BSIG §30(2) Nr. 9. No signup, the result stays with you.
intro.riskAssessmentHint: Already have your inventory? Run the risk assessment per asset.

sectorPicker.question: Which NIS2 sectors apply to your company?
sectorPicker.helpText: Pick all that apply. You can be in more than one sector. Sector-specific questions appear later in the wizard.
sectorPicker.annexIDescription: High-criticality sectors. Proactive BSI supervision, fines up to €10M.
sectorPicker.annexIIDescription: Other critical sectors. Reactive supervision, fines up to €7M.

energy.name: Energy (electricity, district heating, oil, gas, hydrogen)

digital-infrastructure.name: Digital infrastructure (DNS, TLD, cloud, data centre, CDN, trust services)

digital-providers.name: Digital providers (marketplaces, search engines, social networks)

questions.gruppenbildungHint: Grouping is fine. BSI-200-2 §8.1 allows you to count 45 identical laptops as one entry. Tick what you have; we will create one asset per tick.

business-processes.question: What does your company actually do day to day?
business-processes.helpText: Pick the business processes that describe your operations. These become the Geschäftsprozesse layer of the Informationsverbund (BSI §8.1.3).

internal-apps.question: Which software does the company use day to day?
internal-apps.helpText: Tick everything you use. Each tick becomes an Anwendung in your Informationsverbund (BSI §8.1.4).

options.email: Email (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, on-prem Exchange, other)
options.file-storage: Shared file storage (network drive, SharePoint, Google Drive, Dropbox)

it-infrastructure.question: What IT infrastructure does the company run?
it-infrastructure.helpText: Hardware and infrastructure. Each tick becomes an IT-System entry (BSI §8.1.6).

options.onprem-servers: On-premise servers (in your own server room)
options.cloud-services: Cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Hetzner, other)
options.mobile-devices: Mobile devices (phones, tablets) issued to employees
options.network-equipment: Network equipment (firewall, switches, WiFi access points)
options.backup-system: Backup system (NAS, tape, cloud backup service)

geschaeftsprozess.label: Geschäftsprozesse
geschaeftsprozess.description: BSI-200-2 §8.1.3. The business processes your IT supports. Sets the protection-need floor for everything downstream.

anwendung.label: Anwendungen
anwendung.description: BSI-200-2 §8.1.4. Software the processes depend on (email, accounting, CRM, ERP, file storage, cloud services).

it-system.label: IT-Systeme
it-system.description: BSI-200-2 §8.1.6. Hardware and infrastructure (servers, clients, mobile devices, network equipment, ICS, IoT).

raum.label: Räume
raum.description: BSI-200-2 §8.1.7. Physical locations (offices, server rooms, data centres, warehouses, plant sites).

kommunikation.label: Kommunikationsverbindungen
kommunikation.description: BSI-200-2 §8.1.5. Internal and external network connections, VPN, third-party links, internet exposure.

output.heading: Your Informationsverbund (BSI-200-2 §8.1)
output.subtitle: Five-layer structure ready for the §8.2 Schutzbedarfsfeststellung. Each entry has an auto-generated id (P/A/S/R/N + number) following the BSI §8.1 attribute convention.
output.empty: Nothing captured in this layer yet.

disclaimer.methodologyDisclosure: Asset inventory aligned with BSI-200-2 §8.1 Strukturanalyse (five-layer Informationsverbund + Gruppenbildung per Lektion 3). Output is a first-pass inventory you can hand to a consultant or feed into the risk assessment. Full §8.1 conformance also requires a current Netzplan (network diagram), dependency edges between layers, and management body sign-off (§38 BSIG, Art 20 NIS2).
